text: Materials Science and Engineering is an interdisciplinary field that studies the relationship between the composition, structure, preparation process and performance of materials. It covers traditional materials such as metals, ceramics, polymers and composite materials, as well as cutting-edge fields such as nanomaterials, superconducting materials and smart materials. It takes "identifying problems - designing materials - optimizing performance - engineering application" as its core logic, for example: How to make mobile phone screens more durable (reinforced with ceramic materials), battery life longer (developed with new electrode materials), and aero engines more resistant to high temperatures (designed with high-temperature alloys) is a fundamental discipline that drives the transformation of industries such as information technology, new energy, healthcare, and aerospace.
